Hi Sarah / Jamal —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed for the POC and pilot, with the immediate next milestone focused on the load/performance test and capacity sizing. Highlights: 

- Target close (POC -> decision): 2026-07-15
- MAP milestone (Load test): Traffic replay + 2-hour soak; target window: 2026-07-08 to 2026-07-09 (mornings PST)
- Peak QPS (as discussed): please confirm — we have 450 QPS noted in the draft; let me know if you expect 500 QPS or higher
- Responsibilities: Elara to provide traffic replay dataset + test account; Redwood to provision staging/dedicated capacity, run traffic replay, and deliver latency/p99/cost report
- Dependencies: staging access, traffic sample, NDA/SOW as needed, switchover window for staging traffic

Attachments: elara_map_draft_v3.pdf (MAP draft), traffic-replay-sample.json (example)

Can you confirm the peak QPS and whether you want Redwood to provision dedicated capacity for the test? Also confirm if July 8 morning PST works for you. Once we have confirmation I’ll assign internal owners and lock the scheduling.

Next steps for now:
- Sarah/Jamal: confirm peak QPS and preferred test window
- Marissa: finalize MAP and circulate owner assignments

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & sizing — capacity sizing ask

Looping in engineering/infra owners to confirm sizing and runbook. Initial recommendation based on the stated workload (500 QPS peak, 4k token average context, mixed generate/chat model):

- Recommended staging cluster for the Jul 8 test: 3 x A100 80GB equivalent GPUs (dedicated), with autoscale up to 5 nodes for short spikes. If customer prefers H100 equivalents, 2 x H100 would likely provide similar throughput but we should size conservatively.
- Pre-warm: run a 30–45 minute prefix replay to warm KV cache and embeddings cache before the 2-hour soak.
- Test length: 2-hour main soak + 1-hour ramp up/down.
- Observability: collect per-request latency, p50/p90/p99, GPU utilization, token throughput, and cost per 1k tokens. Connor will wire tracing + Prometheus dashboards for the run.
- Dependencies: traffic replay dataset (sample ahead of time), staging access, allowlisted test IPs for the replay agents. We need the full traffic sample by EOD Jul 5 to validate distribution and craft the replay script. 

Action items / owners (internal):
- Aditya: build replay script, run test, collect logs and produce metrics report
- Vivek: provision dedicated nodes and ensure autoscale policies are ready
- Connor: observability dashboards + log collection hooks
- Rishi: confirm whether any temporary Dedicated reservation is required and estimate cost impact for post-test pilot

I’ll draft a short runbook and attach it. We should plan a 30-minute dry run on Jul 7 to validate replay pipeline.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
